discord._comment: Delivery is EITHER a webhook URL (simplest, no bot) OR a bot token + target. webhookUrl wins if both are set.
discord._botAlt: To use a bot instead of a webhook: remove webhookUrl and set botToken + target. Bot needs View Channel + Send Messages + Embed Links.

defaults._comment: Applied to every watch unless the watch overrides the same key.
defaults._priceDrop: Set trackPriceDrops:true on a watch (or here) to also alert on price drops.

watches._site: Generic Shopify — by EAN (resolved via the shop's predictive search) ...
